purpose: Name the difficulty-selected ASCII interaction/resource thresholds and their scene-resource mode destinations.

thresholds.name: INTERACTION_RESOURCE_MODE_1B_MILESTONE
thresholds.consumer: When INTERACTION_RESOURCE_PROGRESS_COUNTER equals this word, enter scene-resource mode 0x1B.

thresholds.name: INTERACTION_RESOURCE_MODE_1C_MILESTONE
thresholds.consumer: When INTERACTION_RESOURCE_PROGRESS_COUNTER equals this word, enter scene-resource mode 0x1C.

producer.name: Level_LoadFromSceneState
producer.operation: Select both four-byte ASCII thresholds from GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE.

conclusion: FF7E12 and FF7E16 are difficulty-selected ASCII milestones for the interaction/resource progress state machine, distinguished by their scene-resource mode targets.
